title: Restore
intro: Unpacks a backup into a separate new folder and lists what differs from what you have now. Nothing is ever written back over your live Claude directories — you decide what to copy back.
leaveHint: Leaving Settings while this runs will stop it.
afterHint: Nothing was written to your live directories. Copy back whatever you need from the folder above.

blocked.not_configured: No backup location has been set yet, so there is nothing to restore from.
blocked.dir_unusable: The backup folder cannot be read right now, so its backups cannot be listed.
blocked.no_bundles: There are no backups in that folder yet.
blocked.script_missing: The restore script is missing from this build of Fledge.
blocked.python3_missing: Restore needs the system python3, which was not found. Install Xcode Command Line Tools with: xcode-select --install

dest.is_root: The filesystem root is not a valid place to unpack into.
dest.is_home: Your home folder is too broad for this. Pick a dedicated folder.
dest.inside_source: That folder sits inside your live Claude data. Unpacking there would fold a full copy back into what gets backed up. Pick somewhere outside your Claude directories.
dest.not_empty: That folder already has something in it. Restore never unpacks on top of existing content — pick an empty or new folder.
dest.not_dir: That path is a file, not a folder.

links.title: Shared setup check (your live directories)
links.none: No broken links — your live shared setup points at this machine.
links.found: {{count}} link(s) in your live shared setup point at a path that no longer exists. This checks your current directories, not the backup you just unpacked — it happens once you move an old machine's setup back into place: a backup stores the links themselves, not the files they point at.
links.notApplicable: Only one account is registered, so there is no shared setup to check.

errors.planFailed: Could not work out where this backup would be unpacked.
errors.runFailed: The restore could not be started.
errors.scanFailed: Could not check the shared setup links.
errors.repairFailed: Could not repoint the shared setup links.
errors.unknown_bundle: That backup is no longer in the backup folder.
errors.dest_invalid: That is not a valid folder path.
errors.bundle_source_ambiguous: You've given both a bundle name and a file path — pick just one.
errors.bundle_path_invalid: Please give the full path to the backup bundle.
errors.bundle_not_found: That file isn't there — it may have been moved or renamed.
errors.bundle_not_a_file: That isn't a file. Pick the backup bundle itself (.tar.gz).
errors.bundle_unreadable: That file can't be read. Check its permissions and try again.
errors.dest_required: This filename doesn't say when the backup was taken, so pick where to unpack it yourself.
